en.heading: Choose adoptive parents for m_c
en.info: If a rabbit is added as an adoptive parent, they will be displayed on the family page and considered a full relative. Adoptive and blood parents will be treated the same; this also applies to siblings.
en.help_tooltip: A rabbit's adoptive parents are set automatically when the rabbit is born. Any rabbits that are mates with the parents at the time of birth are considered adoptive parents. To be a possible adoptive parent, the rabbit has to be 14 moons older than the child.
